roadmapTask: Horizon 14 of agent-agnostic-browser-bridge (tools/chrome-bridge): harden the captureTab page action with an automatic downscale-and-retry ladder for oversized screenshots, and promote the flat MAX_SCREENSHOT_BASE64_CHARS constant into a named documented size policy. Keep the single-capability-across-the-parity-surface shape; close with a mandatory live-Chrome head-to-head. Full-page capture stays out of scope.

dimensionScores.evidence: Scale-without-clip path issues a Runtime.evaluate geometry read (documentElement clientWidth/clientHeight) inside the same withDebuggerSession before building the clip; built clip is {x:0,y:0,width,height,scale} from that read. Unit test stubs geometry to {width:1280,height:800} and asserts the exact capture payload {format:png, clip:{x:0,y:0,width:1280,height:800,scale:0.5}} plus the verbatim Runtime.evaluate client-size expression, and asserts attach/detach. 10-over-9: the geometry expression string is pinned verbatim in both source and test (a regression switching to innerWidth/innerHeight fails the test loudly), and an in-source comment explicitly explains why the documentElement client-size family is used over innerWidth/innerHeight.

scale is declared readonly scale?: number with the 0<scale<=1 bound documented in both the interface comment and option block comment; no-option path starts params as {format:png} and only sets clip for the clip/scale branches, so the two pre-existing payload-assertion tests pass unmodified ({format:png} and {format:png, clip:{...}}). captureScreenshot still returns Promise<string>; label union still capturing|evaluating|scrolling. 9 not 10: the 10-level passCriteria names a dedicated type-level assertion test for the scale field, which is not present (the interface declaration pins it at the type level but there is no dedicated type-level check).

Unit test asserts the scale-without-clip payload exactly (sendCommand ... {format:png, clip:{x:0,y:0,width:1280,height:800,scale:0.5}}) and the element-mode lowered clip.scale payload exactly ({format:png, clip:{x:8859,y:0,width:546,height:1811,scale:0.5}}), proving x/y/width/height preserved with only scale reduced; pre-existing {format:png} and {format:png, clip} assertions remain and pass (no-option path byte-identical). Tests use requested scale as a literal (0.5), never a wildcard/objectContaining matcher. 10-over-9: exact payload objects (not objectContaining) pinned for BOTH cases, no-option path asserted byte-identical by unmodified existing tests, geometry-read expression asserted verbatim so a viewport-mis-read regression is caught.

Grep across debugger-ports.ts and debugger-ports.unit.test.ts for captureBeyondViewport and Emulation. returns NO matches; scaled path issues only Page.captureScreenshot and Runtime.evaluate, builds a clip from documentElement clientWidth/clientHeight — no Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride, no beyond-viewport param. Both doc comments retain the full-page-deliberately-not-offered note citing the horizon-13 phase-0 probe (interface comment + captureScreenshot method comment), both updated to also describe the new scaled-clip capability. New scale option documented in a block comment matching the files existing convention. 10-over-9: BOTH the option-interface comment AND the method comment keep the full-page-not-offered note and add scaled-clip behaviour, AND grep confirms no captureBeyondViewport/Emulation string added.

dimensionScores.evidence: captureDownscaleLadder (page-actions.ts:459-500) is a bounded for..of over the const tuple SCREENSHOT_DOWNSCALE_LADDER_SCALES ([0.75,0.5,0.33 as const]); it returns on the first rung whose length <= ceiling, or after the floor is still over, with no while(true)/recursion/re-push, so halting is provably bounded by rungs.length+1. Tests assert exact counts: viewport fits-on-rung toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2) (line 1167), floor-fits toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4) (1254), and the always-oversized too-large test pins attempts=1+SCREENSHOT_DOWNSCALE_LADDER_SCALES.length (1079,1133). Not a 10: the floor-EXHAUSTED captured:false paths (1061,1100) pin the re-capture count only via the attempts field, not a direct toHaveBeenCalledTimes on captureScreenshot — a 10 would spy the exact captureScreenshot count on BOTH the fits-on-a-rung and the floor-exhausted path.

Constants are co-located and ordered (page-actions.ts:73-91): ladder SCREENSHOT_DOWNSCALE_LADDER_SCALES=[0.75,0.5,0.33] as const, floor SCREENSHOT_DOWNSCALE_FLOOR_SCALE=0.33 === the last rung. The give-up result (lines 492-499) literally carries size (last measured at floor), limit, floor, attempts with reason exactly 'too-large', asserted in tests (1074-1080, 1126-1134). The fits-expactly-at-floor test (1222-1255) asserts captured:true, appliedScale=0.33, attempts=4. No path returns captured:true at a scale below floor. Not a 10: no unit test asserts the rung tuple is sorted strictly descending nor that floor === the ladder's last rung (tests reference the constants but never assert monotonicity), which scale 10 explicitly requires.

git diff on protocol/types.ts is additive: CaptureTabImageResult gains optional appliedScale/attempts; CaptureTabFailureResult gains optional floor/attempts (the size/limit doc comments are reworded but the members are unchanged); CaptureTabParams is still exactly {mode?, elementRef?} (types.ts:85-88); the CaptureTabFailureReason label union is byte-identical; the port signature stays Promise<string> with CaptureScreenshotOptions gaining only optional scale (debugger-ports.ts:71-87). Pre-existing tests compile unchanged and the gate is green. Not a 10: no test or type-level assertion (expectTypeOf/assertType) pins the param shape at exactly two fields.

The ladder helper (page-actions.ts:459-500) never itself calls attach/detach, delegating every (scale)=>Promise<string> recapture to the port, whose withDebuggerSession (debugger-ports.ts:179-235) detaches inside a finally on every path (fit, floor exhaustion, and thrown error). The mid-ladder rejection test (1257-1293) returns a clean captured:false tab-unavailable and stops the walk at captureScreenshot-called-3-times, so no session is left attached. Not 8/10: each rung opens its OWN attach→command→detach session (recapture=captureScreenshot=withDebuggerSession per call) rather than reusing one bounded session as the scale-8 ('ladder reuses the single session') and scale-10 ('does not open a new CDP session per rung') descriptors require, and there is no session-cleanup-spy-called-exactly-once assertion.

Both modes are exercised on every path: viewport first-capture-fits captured:true appliedScale:1 attempts:1 (847), element first-capture-fits appliedScale:1 attempts:1 (900); over-ceiling→fits-on-a-rung for viewport appliedScale:0.75 attempts:2 with toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2) (1138-1167) and for element appliedScale:0.5 attempts:3 (1170-1213); every-rung-over-floor captured:false 'too-large' with size/limit/floor/attempts for BOTH viewport (1061) and element (1100). First-capture-fits routes through captureResultWithLadder's early return (page-actions.ts:435-446) so captureDownscaleLadder is never called; bad-mode/missing-elementRef rejections are unchanged (1295). Not a 10: the element fits-on-a-rung call count is asserted only via attempts:3 rather than toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3), and no direct spy asserts the ladder helper is never invoked on the fit path.

page-actions.ts:51-91 is a single co-located 'size policy' block: the shared doc comment names it as the size policy, lists all three parts (ceiling / ladder rungs / give-up floor), includes the measured baseline and rationale (~845KB at dpr 2; ladder values chosen so a few rungs bring a dense dpr-2 page under the ceiling), and states the floor yields captured:false 'too-large'. Name and value are unchanged: MAX_SCREENSHOT_BASE64_CHARS=1_200_000 (line 73). decisions.md appends exactly one new line explicitly SUPERSEDING the horizon-13 FLAT no-downscale decision (git diff shows a single + line). Not a 10: the 'why chosen' rationale is generic rather than a per-rung justification (0.75 vs 0.5 vs 0.33), and there is no doc/test pinning the ladder as an ordered readonly sequence.

amendments.reason: The phase contract said all downscale rungs stay inside ONE withDebuggerSession, but withDebuggerSession is module-private to the debugger port (chromeCaptureDebuggerPorts closure) and the port exposes only per-call captureScreenshot/evaluate/scroll; debugger-ports.ts is out of this phase's filesAffected, so the ladder drives per-rung captureScreenshot calls instead of one shared session. This matches what the h14 discovery already predicted ('each retry = its own 15s-capped session'). Session lifetime stays bounded and leak-free — each call's port finally detaches, and the mid-ladder rejection test proves no orphan.
amendments.grounding: debugger-ports.ts withDebuggerSession is private to the chromeCaptureDebuggerPorts closure (not exposed on DebuggerPorts); DebuggerPorts exposes captureScreenshot/evaluate/scroll each wrapping their own withDebuggerSession; discovery finding 'CaptureScreenshotOptions / API surface' states each capture call is its own attach→command→detach session under the 15s cap.

changes: All rung attempts stay inside the one existing withDebuggerSession with detach in a finally.
Each rung attempt runs through the port's own captureScreenshot session (attach→command→detach in a finally); the handler never attach/detaches and never opens a wrapper session of its own.
